subject: Post-demo: procurement signal, PO vs card & SOC 2 gating
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@brightpath.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & asks after demo — procurement path + SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Emily / Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side plus a couple of asks to help us align on next steps and procurement readiness:

- Redwood next steps: provide SOC 2 snapshot (summary attached), sample DPA, and our typical SOW/ordering process.
- From the demo: you called out pilot timeline (Q1), and procurement needing a PO + standard redline review.

Could you confirm the following so we know how to prepare the right materials?
1) Preferred commercial routing: (A) Procurement issues PO and we sign Redwood's contract, (B) Card payment to start pilot, or (C) BrightPath prefers marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace / vendor portal).
2) Procurement lead time target and any mandatory procurement/legal reviewers we should expect.
3) Any security questionnaire items we should prioritize (specific control areas or 3rd-party templates).

I've attached a short SOC 2 overview (SOC2-summary.pdf) and our pilot pricing workbook. If marketplace is preferred, we can check listing status and timeline with Partnerships. If PO is required, we'll surface the typical SOW/ordering doc and routing for PO acceptance.

Proposed next step: if you can reply with A/B/C and the procurement contact, I'll coordinate with Sales Ops and Security to turn around the DPA redline and the security questionnaire responses.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@brightpath.com>

Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightpath.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up & asks after demo — procurement path + SOC 2 artifacts

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the recap and the SOC2 summary. Quick answers below:

- Commercial routing: We prefer procurement-issued PO for pilots (option A). Finance requires a PO + signed DPA before we can route payment. Card payment is only acceptable for very small proofs of concept under $5k.
- Marketplace: We are open to marketplace purchases but marketplace listing needs to go through our vendor onboarding and typically adds ~2-3 weeks; procurement prefers a direct PO to expedite.
- Procurement lead time / reviewers: Our procurement lead is Alex Turner (cc'd). Legal will want to review DPA redlines (we use a standard DPA template). Security will run a general questionnaire (we use the Vendor Security Assessment v3 — I attached our intake form).

I attached the procurement intake form for your legal/procurement folks (BrightPath-procurement-intake.pdf). If you can provide a DPA redline and completed security questionnaire answers, we can move to PO issuance. Our timeline aim is to have PO issued by Dec 10 if we can get docs this week.

Regards,
Emily Zhou
Director of Program Operations, BrightPath Health

Rachel / Marissa — quick answers from Commercial Ops: we can accept PO for pilots. Standard policy: we accept PO with Net-30 by default; Net-45 can be approved for strategic pilots on a case-by-case basis (needs manager sign-off). We invoice against the PO and require PO number on the invoice for matching.

Marketplace note: AWS Marketplace listing is an option but isn't the fastest path for a Q1 pilot — it typically takes 10-14 business days to get listings live and onboarded. For your Dec 10 PO target, direct PO is the recommended path.

Discount / approval: for a pilot under $50k we can offer up to a 10% pilot discount; anything beyond that needs Sales Director approval. If you want to propose 10% to lock the PO, I can escalate.

Security / DPA: Security can produce a completed questionnaire (Vendor Security Assessment v3) and provide a SOC 2 type II snapshot. Legal can send a standard DPA redline within 48 hours once we get their intake. I'll attach our procurement guidance doc for routing.

Next steps for Rachel:
- Confirm you want us to propose Net-30 + 10% pilot discount and we'll prepare the DPA redline and completed questionnaire.
- If yes, I will loop Legal + Security and accelerate.

Ben Carter
